messages:
ashok: heads-up, seeing a cohort-level scatter in ap-southeast1 — lots of small GPU pods Pending + many tiny warm nodes underutilized
lucy: link? :eyes:
jordan: happened after last night's rack maintenance?
ashok: heatmap: https://dash.redwood/internal/alloc/heatmap?region=apse1 — pattern shows rack-level reshuffle, affinity groups split across racks, KV cache cooling spikes. quick kubectl snippet: ```$ kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending | grep gpu
research-job-12     Pending   0/1    0s   <none>   <none>   0.0.0.0   <none>```
maria: autoscaler logs show we clipped provision due to cost-guardrail cap at 03:22 UTC — hit commit budget ceiling so no new racks were created
ops-bot: scheduler-alert: 34 pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1 for >5m; grouping suggests affinity mismatch; suggested action: temporary reserve bump or enable burst-preemptible
jordan: could be taints applied during drain — ran `rack-maint=true:NoSchedule` on some nodes last night
kenji: proposal: relax per-az reserved capacity for batch workloads and allow short-lived preemptible burst to smooth packing. also tweak packing: prefer "cohort_locality: preferSameRack" for pods from same ns to reduce KV scatter
maria: +1 but need rollback plan — ensure fallback routing to smaller models if latency-sensitive jobs get preempted
ashok: bumped apse1-a reserve by +12 GPUs and increased warm-pool throttle, starting canary now
lucy: pending dropped 34 -> 9 in dashboard (2m) :thumbsup:
ashok: one pod still flapping: research-job-12 binds to label `gpu-type: t4` but nodes relabeled to `gpu_type=t4a` during image roll — will re-label node or update pod affinity
jordan: runbook: `kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i taint` and `kubectl get nodes -L gpu-type` to validate label drift
kenji: opening operator PR to reconcile simple dash/underscore label drift for gpu-type to avoid manual fixes
maria: follow-ups: (1) run compact job to coalesce tiny pods onto warm nodes, (2) add telemetry for cohort scatter threshold alert, (3) review cost-guardrail policy for short burst exceptions
ashok: will push scheduler flag patch and update incident thread when stable
ops-bot: incident resolved: pending count < 5 for 10m; monitoring for 60m
